name: The Thirteenth Summer
pitch: You are awake one year in thirteen, and the twelve you spend in the ground pay the cooldown on one art, so a Qi Refining child climbs out, kills a Core elder in half a second, and goes back down without finding out how it ended.

new.name: Cicada Root
new.effect: Innate, no parents, innate_chance 0.001. Per purity point: one buried season pays 0.2 s of one art's authored cooldown. Buried 12 years in 13, ageing at a quarter speed, a sleeping body with no arts or ward. Own sector as rule 12. Counts toward n_eff. Cost: nearly a whole life.

new.name: Paid in the Ground
new.effect: One art's timer runs while you are buried, never below cooldown_min, and the seconds paid are reported.
new.second_home: any long seclusion rule, if the user wants one

new.name: Brood Year
new.effect: One year in thirteen, world-wide, every holder wakes for four seasons. Sleeping through a waking keeps paying, up to 3 cycles.

new.name: The Long Note
new.effect: Qi, song. c_art 145.23, cost 0.04, authored cooldown 576 s at purity 60 and one waking.

new.name: Slow Art Damage
new.effect: Small +3, notable +15, on arts with an authored cooldown of 10 s or more.
new.second_home: The Fortieth Breath, any long-cooldown art

new.name: Heavy Note
new.effect: +20 to arts with an authored cooldown of 20 s or more.

new.name: Slough Powder
new.effect: L4 +40 to your next art, ground from your own last husk. One a waking.

new.name: Hidden Pit
new.effect: Hides a burial. Twelve years of upkeep, paid by someone awake.

new.name: Under the Roots Method
new.effect: Main, Hoàng giai, names only the Cicada Root. Holds the three arts.

questions: Forum Build's sentence was a wait is paid, never deleted. Is a wait paid in years of a life the price the user had in mind, and what should a season buy?
A forced twelve-year skip removes most of a life from play. Is that a fantasy or a chore, and does it need a choice at each burial?
About five holders wake together each Brood Year. Should NPC holders be allowed to spend a note, given a world of about 27 Nascent Souls?
